text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_storage_account.public","doc_id":"POL-001","attribute":"allow_nested_items_to_be_public","title":"azurerm_storage_account.public sets allow_nested_items_to_be_public to \"true\", which violates the requirement to keep blob containers non-public and prevents anonymous access.","suggestion":"Set allow_nested_items_to_be_public to false.","breaks_standard":true}]}
